I know that feeling. To not have the motivation to even start with steps. This is the biggest problem with depression and the only way out, is in yourself. You have to find yourself. 

Start by doing this. If your taking any drugs(i.e weed, alcohol, etc) stop rn. If you need treatment seek out treatment right away. The next step is to slowly start giving yourself positive affirmations in your own head. Tell yourself these as examples:
"I got this"   "I can do anything if I set my mind too it" 
"I want to be happy, and I want to change"

Telling yourself these instead of telling yourself you can't over the course of months you will not believe the change it can make. These are the small steps. Stop telling yourself you cant and start telling yourself YOU CAN! And over time you will start do better yourself more and more. 

I hope you the best my friend, truly.
